_comment: W1 JH04 — three voluntary task template drafts. Target collection: task_templates (owner: Xiang Yu / Junhan Huang; uniqueKeys: []). These are DRAFTS for Jiawei Fang (W1 JF02) and Qizhen Chen (W1 QC02) to build interaction samples from. They are not published content.
_status: draft — pending review; not inserted into any environment
_consumers: Qizhen Chen — back-office task template form prototype

_constraints.maxSuggestions: The plan caps suggestions at 3 per day; keep the draft set at or below that.
_constraints.noFiction: No synthetic address, phone number or contact detail may appear in any template.
_constraints.pendingVerification: Items without a reliable source stay in an empty 'pending verification' state — never placeholder text.

_templateShapeWarning: The task_templates field list is NOT pinned in database/collections.json (uniqueKeys is empty). The shape below is a proposal; align it with Xiang Yu's data dictionary (W1 XY01) before implementation.

templates.title: 去一个没去过的地方
templates.intent: Encourage a student to visit an unfamiliar campus place.

templates.title: 今天的天气像什么？
templates.intent: Offer a lightweight mood/weather choice that can be answered without writing a journal entry.
templates.inputRequired: single choice; tags and text remain optional
templates.dependency: The five weather keys must match Jiaqi Zhu's icon set and the shared constants (W1 JQ02 + miniprogram/shared/constants.js).

templates.title: 帮忙确认一条地点信息
templates.intent: Route a student's observation into the place verification loop instead of a free-form public submission.
templates.inputRequired: optional note when 'CHANGED' is chosen; length reuses the campus.correctPlace limit of 1-200 Unicode code points
templates.boundary: No public submission or comment entry point. place_corrections notes: 'Private submitter/operator review; no automatic publication.'
